_thisFileIsOptional: Every field below has a working default, and the app starts with no config file at all — copy this to harness.config.json only to change something. See src/server/config.ts for the defaults: the vault goes in ~/Documents/Engram, the student id is your OS username, and the Engram MCP server is found automatically (installed dependency, then a sibling checkout, or ENGRAM_ENTRY).
_modelRoutes: models.*.model supports three routes, mixable per role: a plain id (e.g. "claude-sonnet-5") routes through the Anthropic API and needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY — the app will ask for one on first run and save it outside the vault; "ollama:<model>" routes to a local Ollama model (OLLAMA_BASE_URL to move it, OLLAMA_API_KEY if yours sits behind an authenticated proxy); "openai:<model>" (e.g. "openai:deepseek/deepseek-chat") routes to any OpenAI-compatible provider — set OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL and, if the provider requires a key, OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY. See README 'Model routes' for the full writeup.
_search: Only needed for an ollama: tutor. An Anthropic-routed tutor researches via Anthropic's server-side web search with nothing to install.
